page.overview:
What is Assassination attempt on Boba Fett?

An assassination attempt on Boba Fett, the Daimyo of the planet Tatooine, took place in 9 ABY where a Hutt brother and sister, the twin cousins of Jabba Desilijic Tiure, sent the Wookiee bounty hunter Krrsantan to assassinate the Daimyo.
